requests.title: A production standing adult body, with head, hair and wardrobe that fit it

consumer.playerVisibleUse: The player's own character, standing in the room the title screen shows them.

requests.whyNeeded: Five production rooms are registered and painting. Not one person can be composed into any of them, so every character-bearing surface falls to a room with a name on it. This is the single asset that unblocks the most surfaces at once.

inventoryCheck.found: Four standing cells arrived on the Packet 71 body sheet — two standing-neutral and two standing-conversational — in one consistent family measured at 6.8 to 7.2 heads tall. The figures are right. The silhouette is not: it carries a green contour on 67 to 80 percent of its soft-edge pixels, which the approved style authority does not have and which is plainly visible at the ~250 plate pixels a body actually paints at.
inventoryCheck.shortfall: The cells are banked under art/generated/candidates/ocd-p71/bodies with per-cell measurements in art/qa/p71/source_intake_dispositions.json. Every one is REVISE. No attachment anchors are authored, because D-068 requires them measured from the raster that ships and this raster is being re-exported.

generationRecipe: One adult body in a relaxed standing pose, facing the camera, whole figure inside the canvas with the feet clear of the bottom edge.
True transparency everywhere that is not the figure. No painted ground, no shadow baked into the alpha.
Neutral undergarment-level body so tops, bottoms and footwear composite over it; not a finished outfit.
Grounded semi-realistic illustrated rendering matching the style authority. Not photographic, not cartooned.
No face or hair painted into the body: the head and hair are separate components.
acceptanceCriteria: Magic bytes are PNG and the alpha channel carries real per-pixel transparency, not a matte.
Six named semantic anchors descend the body in order, with the garment hips at or below the pelvis root.
Composes with a released head, hair, top, bottom and footwear into a complete plan with no missing layer.
Human visual approval recorded separately from intake acceptance.

requests.title: Re-export the adult body sheet without the green silhouette contour

consumer.playerVisibleUse: Any character standing or sitting in any of the six production rooms.

requests.whyNeeded: This is the only thing between the project and its first usable person. The eight poses, the body family, the proportions and the alpha are all right; every cell is held back by one edge treatment.

inventoryCheck.found: The 5056x3392 eight-pose sheet, measured here. Fully transparent pixels carry zero colour, so the background is clean; the defect is confined to the partially-transparent edge, where 67-80 percent of pixels per cell are green-dominant at a mean of roughly (43,79,30). It totals 8.4 percent of the figure's own opaque area. A CORRECTED SINGLE POSE ARRIVED DURING THIS RUN: Drive root IMG_5192.PNG, 5056x3392 RGBA, uploaded 2026-09-04 14:24. It is the standing-conversational pose from this same family with ZERO green-dominant soft-edge pixels, measured the same way — so the fix is confirmed possible and this request is now about re-exporting the remaining seven poses the same way. It is an unclassified Drive-root upload with no managed copy, so it was measured but NOT ingested.
inventoryCheck.shortfall: The approved style authority PG_STYLE_REFERENCE_CHARACTER_P005_APPROVED.png has no silhouette stroke of any colour, so this is out of family rather than house style. Removing it here would mean rewriting the colour of pixels I cannot verify the correct value of, which is a repair the pipeline should not make silently.

target.styleAuthority: The Packet 71 sheet itself for body and pose; PG_STYLE_REFERENCE_CHARACTER_P005_APPROVED.png for edge treatment

Change nothing else: same body family, same mass and silhouette, same eight poses, same neutral grey bra and briefs, same bare feet, same blank head form.
Transparent background with a clean anti-aliased edge and no matte colour carried into the semi-transparent pixels.
If the green line is a deliberate style choice rather than a keying artefact, say so and the project will treat it as house style instead.
acceptanceCriteria: Green-dominant pixels are under 2 percent of soft-edge pixels in every cell, measured the same way.
The eight poses still segment into eight cells with npm run chop:source-sheet.

Matches the edge quality already achieved by IMG_5192.PNG, which measured 0.00% green-dominant soft-edge pixels.
